activity.notes: Charles of Bourbon obtained the Kingdom of Naples in 1734 and ruled it until 1759, when he abdicated the Italian crowns to succeed to the Spanish throne. ATLAS records the Neapolitan kingship separately from Spain and Sicily.

sources.title: Carlos de Borbón, un monarca entre Nápoles y España — Museo Nacional del Prado
sources.citation_text: The Prado states that Charles received the Kingdom of Naples and Sicily in 1734, ruled there for twenty-five years, and abdicated in 1759 to succeed to the Spanish crown.
